title: The supplied pullback/tensor operations and their compatibility square
statement: For functors I:A→A′, J:B→B′, F:A→B, G:A′→B′, curried tensors on the four categories, two pullback/tensor maps φ and ψ, an isomorphism a:F;J≅I;G, and the two inclusion tensorators mA and mB, define projectionTensorComparisonComponent at M,N to be the expanded five-factor comparison square. It is exactly the component equation of comparison compatibility. This module also hosts the four unchanged definitions previously declared in CommonProjectionPullbackTensorCompatibility; their bodies and signatures are relocated verbatim.

source.place: Compatibility; finite-stage representative and supplied-operation normalization.

lean.statement:
def projectionTensorComparisonComponent
    {A B A' B' : Type*} [Category* A] [Category* B] [Category* A'] [Category* B']
    (I : A ⥤ A') (J : B ⥤ B')
    {F : A ⥤ B} {G : A' ⥤ B'}
    {TA : A ⥤ A ⥤ A} {TB : B ⥤ B ⥤ B}
    {TA' : A' ⥤ A' ⥤ A'} {TB' : B' ⥤ B' ⥤ B'}
    (φ : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj F).obj TA ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj F).obj F).obj TB)
    (ψ : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj G).obj TA' ⟶
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj G).obj G).obj TB')
    (a : F ⋙ J ≅ I ⋙ G)
    (mA : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj I).obj TA ≅
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj I).obj I).obj TA')
    (mB : (Functor.postcompose₂.obj J).obj TB ≅
      (((Functor.whiskeringLeft₂ _).obj J).obj J).obj TB')
    (M N : A) : Prop
